latest_release.name: Release v2.1.2
latest_release.body:
## Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://install.duxlabs.dev | sh
```

## Assets

### Complete Packages
- **`dms-full-amd64.tar.gz`** - Complete package for x86_64 systems (CLI binaries + QML source + shell completions + installation guide)
- **`dms-full-arm64.tar.gz`** - Complete package for ARM64 systems (CLI binaries + QML source + shell completions + installation guide)
- **`dms-full-freebsd-amd64.tar.gz`** - Complete package for FreeBSD x86_64 systems
- **`dms-full-freebsd-arm64.tar.gz`** - Complete package for FreeBSD ARM64 systems

### Individual Components
- **`dms-cli-amd64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary for x86_64 systems
- **`dms-cli-arm64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary for ARM64 systems
- **`dms-cli-freebsd-amd64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary for FreeBSD x86_64 systems
- **`dms-cli-freebsd-arm64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary for FreeBSD ARM64 systems
- **`dms-distropkg-amd64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary built with distro_package tag for AMD64 systems
- **`dms-distropkg-arm64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary built with distro_package tag for ARM64 systems
- **`dms-distropkg-freebsd-amd64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary built with distro_package tag for FreeBSD x86_64 systems
- **`dms-distropkg-freebsd-arm64.gz`** - DMS CLI binary built with distro_package tag for FreeBSD ARM64 systems
- **`duxinstall-amd64.gz`** - Installer binary for x86_64 systems
- **`duxinstall-arm64.gz`** - Installer binary for ARM64 systems
- **`dms-cli-<version>.tar.gz`** - Go source code with vendored modules (for distro packaging)
- **`dms-qml.tar.gz`** - QML source code only
- **`dms-source.tar.gz`** - Full repository source with bundled DCommon (for distro packaging)

### Checksums
- **`*.sha256`** - SHA256 checksums for verifying download integrity

**Installation:** Extract the `dms-full-*.tar.gz` package for your architecture and follow the `INSTALL.md` instructions inside.

---

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- fix: pass through horizontal scroll for running apps widget by @kanghengliu in #4170
- sysmon: keep search bar keys in the search bar by @Conava in #4172
- island: fix floating dot drag on hyprland w/touch by @purian23 (5144e3f)
- fix star-history by @bbedward (d3daa0b)
- sysmon: only inherit process icons from apps by @Conava in #4173
- core: raise the qml js stack limit by @cmleon51 in #4194
- island: fix pill alignment and bar flicker in a bar by @Conava in #4199
- network: keep every trusted openconnect pin for multi-node gateways by @martinvalentine in #4201

### Other Changes
- launcher: fuzzy match names with fzf and a coherence gate dankinstall: support lmde and soplos by @bbedward (2f2729d)
- bar/media: default scroll behavior to nothing by @bbedward (2129c63)
- ci: auto-review known contributors by @bbedward (f140a12)
- ci: show review progress in a single comment by @bbedward (8ca456b)
- tailscale: talk to the localapi socket directly by @bbedward (a770522)
- core: update gentoo installer deps by @purian23 (46afcb9)
- duxinstall: write layer commands to a script so long lines are not cut off by @purian23 (214d073)
- bump qml-common by @bbedward (c0f8e3a)
- revert feature ports from stable-2.1 by @bbedward (84afade)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell/compare/v2.1.1...v2.1.2

detail.readme:
# Dux Modular Shell
### A modern desktop shell for Wayland Built with [Quickshell](https://quickshell.org/) and [Go](https://go.dev/), running on [dux-qt-base](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-qt-base) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-duxlabs.dev-9ccbfb?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418)](https://duxlabs.dev/docs) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418&color=ffd700)](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell/stargazers) [![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418&color=b9c8da)](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell/blob/master/LICENSE) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418&color=9ccbfb)](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-shell/releases) [![Arch version](https://img.shields.io/archlinux/v/extra/x86_64/dux-shell?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418&color=9ccbfb)](https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/dux-shell/) [![AUR version (git)]()](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/dux-shell-git) [![Ko-Fi donate](https://img.shields.io/badge/donate-kofi?style=for-the-badge&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=ffffff&label=ko-fi&labelColor=101418&color=f16061&link=https%3A%2F%2Fko-fi.com%2Fduxlabs)](https://ko-fi.com/duxlabs) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1387519366651842574?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=101418&color=9ccbfb&label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/ppWTpKmPgT)
Dux Modular Shell (DMS) is a complete desktop shell for [niri](https://github.com/YaLTeR/niri), [Hyprland](https://hyprland.org/), [MangoWC](https://github.com/DreamMaoMao/mangowc), [Sway](https://swaywm.org), [labwc](https://labwc.github.io/), [Scroll](https://github.com/dawsers/scroll), [Miracle WM](https://github.com/miracle-wm-org/miracle-wm), and other Wayland compositors. It replaces waybar, swaylock, swayidle, mako, fuzzel, polkit, and everything else you'd normally stitch together to make a desktop. ## Repository Structure This is a monorepo containing both the shell interface and the core backend services: ``` dux-shell/ ├── quickshell/ # QML-based shell interface │ ├── Modules/ # UI components (panels, widgets, overlays) │ ├── Services/ # System integration (audio, network, bluetooth) │ ├── Widgets/ # Reusable UI controls │ └── Common/ # Shared resources and themes ├── core/ # Go backend and CLI │ ├── cmd/ # dms CLI and duxinstall binaries │ ├── internal/ # System integration, IPC, distro support │ └── pkg/ # Shared packages ├── distro/ # Distribution packaging │ ├── fedora/ # Fedora RPM specs │ ├── debian/ # Debian packaging │ └── nix/ # NixOS/home-manager modules └── flake.nix # Nix flake for declarative installation ``` ## See it in Action
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d310418b-cc44-4ace-ac0d-2fc0c851291d
More Screenshots
## Installation ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.duxlabs.dev | sh ``` One command installs DMS and all dependencies on Arch, Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu, openSUSE, or Gentoo. **FreeBSD:** native support is included in-tree; see [distro/freebsd/README.md](distro/freebsd/README.md) for supported integrations and setup notes. **[Manual installation guide](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/installation)** ## Features **Dynamic Theming** Wallpaper-based color schemes that automatically theme GTK, Qt, terminals, editors (vscode, vscodium), and more using [matugen](https://github.com/InioX/matugen) and dank16. **System Monitoring** Real-time CPU, RAM, GPU metrics and temperatures built into the dms daemon (powered by [dgop](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-gop)). Process list with search and management. **Powerful Launcher** Spotlight-style search for applications, files ([dsearch](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-search)), emojis, running windows, calculator, and commands. Extensible with plugins. **Control Center** Unified interface for network, Bluetooth, audio devices, display settings, and night mode. **Smart Notifications** Notification center with grouping, rich text support, and keyboard navigation. **Media Integration** MPRIS player controls, calendar sync, weather widgets, and clipboard history with image previews. **Session Management** Lock screen, idle detection, auto-lock/suspend with separate AC/battery settings, and a settings front-end for [dux-greeter](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-greeter). **Plugin System** Extend functionality with the [plugin registry](https://plugins.duxlabs.dev). DMS keeps `~/.config/dms/plugins.lock.json` synchronized with managed plugin installs and their exact Git commits, so the same plugins can be reproduced on another machine. ## Supported Compositors Works best with [niri](https://github.com/YaLTeR/niri), [Hyprland](https://hyprland.org/), [Sway](https://swaywm.org/), [MangoWC](https://github.com/DreamMaoMao/mangowc), [labwc](https://labwc.github.io/), [Scroll](https://github.com/dawsers/scroll), and [Miracle WM](https://github.com/miracle-wm-org/miracle-wm) with full workspace switching, overview integration, and monitor management. Other Wayland compositors work with reduced features. [Compositor configuration guide](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/compositors) ## Command Line Interface Control the shell from the command line or keybinds: ```bash dms run # Start the shell dms ipc call spotlight toggle dms ipc call audio setvolume 50 dms ipc call wallpaper set /path/to/image.jpg dms brightness list # List available displays dms plugins search # Browse plugin registry dms plugins lock # Refresh the portable plugin lockfile dms plugins restore ~/plugins.lock.json ``` [Full CLI and IPC documentation](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/keybinds-ipc) ## Documentation - **Website:** [duxlabs.dev](https://duxlabs.dev) - **Docs:** [duxlabs.dev/docs](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/) - **Theming:** [Application themes](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/application-themes) | [Custom themes](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/custom-themes) - **Plugins:** [Development guide](https://duxlabs.dev/docs/dms/plugins-overview) - **Support:** [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/duxlabs) ## Dux Projects DMS is one piece of the suite. The rest lives in its own repos: - [dux-greeter](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-greeter) - greetd login screen with the DMS aesthetic. The Greeter tab in DMS settings is the front-end for it. - [dux-calendar](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-calendar) - Local, Google, Microsoft, and CalDAV calendars for the Dux desktop. - [dux-files](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-files) - File manager for the Dux desktop; also serves the FileManager1 and portal file chooser D-Bus services. - [dgop](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-gop) - System monitoring TUI and Go library; its library powers the process list and dashboard widgets inside the dms daemon. - [dsearch](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-search) - Fast file search that powers file results in the launcher. - [dux-qml-common](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-qml-common) - Shared QML widgets and components used by DMS, dux-greeter, dux-calendar, and dux-files. - [dux-go](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-go) - Common Go modules behind the single binary apps. ## Development See component-specific documentation: - **[quickshell/](quickshell/)** - QML shell development, widgets, and modules - **[core/](core/)** - Go backend, CLI tools, and system integration - **[distro/](distro/)** - Distribution packaging (Fedora, Debian, NixOS) See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for editor setup, the i18n workflow, and Go style guidelines. ### Building from Source **Core + Duxinstall:** ```bash cd core make # Build dms CLI make duxinstall # Build installer ``` **Shell:** ```bash quickshell -p quickshell/ ``` **NixOS:** ```nix { inputs.dms.url = "github:duxlabs-dev/dux-shell"; # Use in home-manager or NixOS configuration imports = [ inputs.dms.homeModules.dank-material-shell ]; } ``` ## Contributing Contributions welcome. Bug fixes, widgets, features, translation, documentation and plugins all help. - For code contributions, see [Development](#development) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) - Translations are managed through POEditor: [DMS on POEditor](https://poeditor.com/join/project/kyeCPTpmJM) - For documentation contributions, see [dux-docs](https://github.com/duxlabs-dev/dux-docs) - If you want to discuss designs or need help with contributing, join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/ppWTpKmPgT) ## Credits - [quickshell](https://quickshell.org/) - Shell framework - [niri](https://github.com/YaLTeR/niri) - Scrolling window manager - [Ly-sec](http://github.com/ly-sec) - Wallpaper effects from [Noctalia](https://github.com/noctalia-dev/noctalia-shell) - [soramanew](https://github.com/soramanew) - [Caelestia](https://github.com/caelestia-dots/shell) inspiration - [end-4](https://github.com/end-4) - [dots-hyprland](https://github.com/end-4/dots-hyprland) inspiration - [Reverier-Xu](https://github.com/Reverier-Xu) - [Ori-fcitx5](https://github.com/Reverier-Xu/Ori-fcitx5) inspiration for Fcitx5 theme ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=duxlabs-dev/dux-shell&type=Date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/#duxlabs-dev/dux-shell&Date) ## License MIT License - See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
